record.question: All of the following are clinical manifestations of opioid poisoning EXCEPT:
options: Narrowing of the size of the pupil
record.explanation: Answer C: Rapid rise in blood pressure. Opioid toxidrome typically includes miosis, depressed respiratory rate, and reduced consciousness; a rapid rise in blood pressure is not a characteristic manifestation. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470415/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
